info.title: Freya Bank voice assistant: statement and debt services

post.summary: Called with the customer number; gives back the customer's cards the assistant may talk about.

customerNo.description: Customer number handed over by the phone menu, e.g. "90000001". May be sent as a string or as a number, both are accepted.

aiFlow.description: Tells the bank which use case is asking; for this one it is "CardOps" (not validated in test).

call.description: Call metadata the bank logs; nothing in the contract depends on it and the test environment ignores it.

200.description: Success when result.returnCode is "1". Errors (no data object): 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 (customer has no valid card, WARNING), 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR, 500 FBE00099.

cards.description: Only active cards come back. Two cards can have the same product name and the same last four digits.

cardNumber.description: Card number; in the test environment masked, first 6 and last 4 digits visible (e.g. 540000******1234). Send it to the other services exactly as returned here.

cardNumberLast4.description: Last four digits of the card. Not necessarily unique.

productName.description: Card product name, free text from the card system; can be empty.

status.description: Card status; only active cards ("A") come back.

isMainCard.description: false for a card that isn't the customer's own main card.

validCardsCount.description: Number of valid cards in the list.

returnCode.description: "1" on success, otherwise the error code. Same value as code.

messageText.description: Message for logs; not to be read to the caller. Same value as message.

type.description: null on success; "ERROR" or "WARNING" on errors.

rootCause.description: Diagnostic string; log it, don't branch on it.

errorOrigin.description: Diagnostic string; log it, don't branch on it.

post.summary: Called with the card number; gives back statement and due dates and the debt per currency.

cardNumber.description: Card number exactly as cards.list returned it (e.g. 540000******1234).

call.description: Call metadata the bank logs; ignored by the test environment.

200.description: Success when result.returnCode is "1". Errors (no data object): 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR (empty card number), 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_120 (card not found), 500 FBE00099.

cardNumber.description: Masked differently from the card list (first 4 + last 4, e.g. 5400********1234). Don't use it to match against the list.

cardNumberLast4.description: Last four digits of the card.

statementDate.description: Date of the last issued statement, dd.MM.yyyy.

lastPayDate.description: Due date of the last issued statement, dd.MM.yyyy.

debtTL.description: Turkish Lira debt block. A block can be missing; missing is not the same as NO_DEBT.

statementPaymentStatus.description: Statement debt status for this currency.

transferAmount.description: Amount carried over from the previous period.

remainingDebt.description: What is left of the statement debt after payments made since.

remainingMinPayment.description: What is left of the minimum payment after payments made since.

totalDebt.description: Total debt including spending after the statement; can be negative (credit balance).

totalDebtPaymentStatus.description: Total debt status for this currency.

remainAutomaticPaymentAmount.description: Remaining automatic payment amount; only meaningful when automaticPaymentFlag is "Y".

debtUSD.description: US Dollar debt block. A block can be missing; missing is not the same as NO_DEBT.

debtGBP.description: Pound Sterling debt block. A block can be missing (some cards have no GBP block at all); missing is not the same as NO_DEBT.

statementWeek.description: New statement week, returned as a string here.

statementDay.description: Returned as a string here; ignore it, the dates to tell the caller are the ones from statement.week.decide.

ibanEmail.description: The registered e-mail address; empty string when no e-mail is registered.

ttsEmail.description: The same address prepared for reading aloud; empty string when no e-mail is registered.

emailAddress.description: Address the statement is sent to; the backend does not check it against the registered address.
